full_prompt_en: A square, ink-and-color landscape painting shows a quiet riverside dwelling among trees and rocky banks beneath faint mountain peaks on aged cream paper. The upper background stays mostly pale and open, with distant ridges drawn in thin gray-brown strokes that fade into a light wash. Their irregular silhouettes rise behind a soft veil of mist, leaving the center of the scene airy. On the left, a group of tall trees leans over the bank. Their dark, slender trunks and layered blue-green foliage form the largest dense mass in the painting. Smaller branches and scrubby growth spread across the foreground rocks, where broken ink lines and touches of warm gray describe rough surfaces. To the right of center, a low white house with brown roofs sits among muted trees. Its windows and roof edges are defined with economical fine lines, and the building remains partly surrounded by foliage rather than standing apart from the landscape. In the foreground, blue-green water widens toward the lower edge and narrows as it passes between the banks. Darker turquoise bands near the left bank suggest reflected trees, while pale, nearly unpainted passages give the water a calm surface. Rounded stones interrupt the stream in the middle distance; larger rock groups line both sides. The right bank is quieter and more open, with a few thin branches reaching into the space above the water. Near the upper-right margin, a narrow column of dark marks resembles calligraphy, but the characters cannot be read clearly at this scale. Color is translucent and restrained: dusty blue-green trees and water sit against warm beige paper, with brown ink carrying the main structural detail. Gentle diffuse daylight seems to fill the scene evenly, and mist softens the distant mountains while the nearer trees retain stronger contrast. The overall composition guides the eye upstream from the broad foreground water to the secluded house, combining spacious pale distance with textured, clustered banks.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形水墨设色山水画：安静的河畔屋舍处于树林和石岸之间，淡远山峰隐现在泛旧的米色纸面上。上方背景大多浅淡开阔，远处山脊由纤细的灰褐笔触画出，渐渐融入轻薄水色。起伏不齐的山形隔着一层薄雾升起，使画面中央保持通透。左侧一组高树向岸边倾展。深色细树干与层叠蓝绿色树冠构成画中最大的密集形块。较小枝条和杂生草木散布于前景岩石，断续墨线和暖灰色触笔描出粗糙表面。中央偏右，一座褐色屋顶的低矮白屋坐落在低调的树木间。门窗与屋檐用节省的细线界定，屋子仍被树丛部分包围，并非独立于山水之外。前景蓝绿色水面朝下缘展开，穿过两岸时逐渐收窄。左岸附近较深的青绿带暗示树影倒映，近乎留白的浅色区域让水面显得平静。圆石在中景打断溪流，更大的石群排列于两岸。右岸更安静、开阔，几根细枝伸入水面上方的空间。右上边缘有一列深色笔迹，像是题字，但在此尺度下无法清楚辨认字形。设色透明而克制：蒙尘的蓝绿色树林与水面置于暖米色纸底上，褐墨承担主要结构细节。柔和漫射的日光似乎均匀铺满画面，薄雾柔化了远山，较近的树林则保留较强对比。整体构图引导视线从宽阔的前景水面溯流而上，抵达隐于林中的屋舍，把开阔淡远的空间与肌理繁密的两岸结合。
style_prompt_en: Ink-and-color painting combines fine, broken linear structure with translucent pools of pigment on a warm paper ground. Cool blue-green areas gather into textured masses and drift into pale, misty intervals; warm gray and brown marks anchor the softer washes. Near forms carry sharper dark accents and clustered small strokes, while distant forms lose both saturation and edge definition. Reserved paper becomes luminous open space, allowing dense passages to feel measured rather than crowded. Diffuse light has no hard cast shadow; depth comes from overlapping silhouettes, alternating density, and gradual fading into the pale ground. The overall visual rhythm is contemplative and spacious, with lively granular detail held inside a restrained color range.
style_prompt_zh: 水墨设色绘画把纤细断续的线性结构与暖色纸底上的透明颜料积染结合。冷蓝绿色区域聚成有肌理的形块，再向浅淡朦胧的间隙散开；暖灰与褐色笔迹稳住较柔软的水色。近处形体带有更清楚的深色强调和密集小笔触，远处形体则同时失去饱和度和边界清晰度。保留的纸面成为明亮的开放空间，让繁密段落显得有节制而不拥挤。漫射光没有硬投影，纵深来自剪影重叠、疏密交替和向浅色底逐渐淡去的过程。整体视觉节奏沉静而开阔，活跃的颗粒细节收束在克制的色域中。
theme_en: A riverside dwelling among blue-green trees, rocks and misty mountains
theme_zh: 蓝绿树林与岩石间的河畔屋舍，远处是朦胧山峦
name: Zhang Daqian
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
